$comment: Z Clear — manual driver check-in. Synthetic sample only. This records an agency-owned observation in the case timeline; there is no live border feed and no ASYCUDA/ZRA update.

assignDriver.scope: Agency staff only. The driver must be an active user of the same tenant. The assignment is audited as shipment.driver_assigned.

checkIn.scope: Only the driver assigned to this shipment in this tenant can check in. Unassigned, other-tenant and other-role requests are denied. Throttled to 30 per minute.

sampleResponse.note: Border check-in at Kasumbalesa: Synthetic sample check-in

guardrails: The stage is unchanged: a check-in is an observation, not a customs decision, a release or an assessment.
Check-ins are append-only shipment_events with source=driver; the state change also writes an audit entry.
Drivers have no access to invoices, reviews, quotes, exports or documents; their shipment list and detail are limited to assigned cases.
